name: Getting started
summary: Spin up a simple Weather Agent powered by Foundry Hosted Agents.
use_when: You're new to the loop and want the shortest path from zero to a running agent.

name: Enterprise Knowledge Grounding
summary: Build an HR onboarding assistant grounded in mock policy documents through Foundry IQ agentic retrieval.
use_when: Answers must be grounded in enterprise knowledge with citations, access control, and repeatable ingestion.

name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
summary: Coordinate a product launch with a MAF workflow, MAF specialists, and a Copilot SDK research agent.
use_when: A workflow needs heterogeneous agents collaborating through typed hand-offs and governed skills.

name: Governance & Safety Baseline
summary: Build a governed insurance claims assistant with policy boundaries, safety controls, and red-team gates.
use_when: A regulated assistant must minimize sensitive data, enforce decision boundaries, and audit every action.

name: Continuous Evaluation Loop
summary: Continuously evaluate a retail support agent and attribute regressions to governed skill versions.
use_when: You need production trace mining, versioned regression sets, and evidence-backed improvement PRs.

name: Voice-First Agent Blueprint
summary: Build a real-time hotel concierge with streaming speech, barge-in, and governed guest-service procedures.
use_when: A spoken guest experience needs low latency, tool use, and reliable staff escalation.

name: Bring Your Own Skills
summary: Bring existing agent skills into a project and graduate them into governed, versioned Foundry assets.
use_when: Proven local or GitHub-hosted skills need enterprise identity, governed distribution, evals, and rollback.
